`npm run ci` now passes. The unit test and both Playwright tests succeed.

**What was wrong:** The e2e test `e2e/security.spec.js` signs in, signs out, then replays the old cookies against `/api/notes`. It expects a 401 and got a 200. The `/logout` handler in `app.js` cleared the cookies in the browser and deleted the API token, but it never removed the session from the server's `sessions` map. Anyone holding a copy of the old `sid` cookie could keep using the session until it expired after an hour.

**What I changed:** I added one line to the `/logout` handler in `app.js`, `sessions.delete(req.cookies.sid);`. Logout now revokes the session on the server. I didn't touch the test, since it was catching a real security bug.

I haven't committed anything.
